title: The 3rd Future Animation Program Showcase (anifest 2026)

title_lang.zh_hk: 第三屆「明日動畫」支援計劃作品展 (anifest動画藝術祭2026)

synopsis: This program features six animation works created with the aid of artificial intelligence: REFRAME, which leverages AI to heal psychological trauma; Tuen Mun vs Tin Shui Wai, an epic battle between aliens and robots; Cirkillation, an atmospheric exploration of suspense and solitude; Tai Lung Fung – Full Throttle Kitchen, a quest to recapture tastes and emotions; Airbag, an existential contemplation on the meaning of life; and Odium Zero, a tale of catastrophe triggered by a lie.

synopsis_lang.en: This program features six animation works created with the aid of artificial intelligence: REFRAME, which leverages AI to heal psychological trauma; Tuen Mun vs Tin Shui Wai, an epic battle between aliens and robots; Cirkillation, an atmospheric exploration of suspense and solitude; Tai Lung Fung – Full Throttle Kitchen, a quest to recapture tastes and emotions; Airbag, an existential contemplation on the meaning of life; and Odium Zero, a tale of catastrophe triggered by a lie.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 本節目將會放映六部由人工智能輔助創作的動畫短片，包括：以AI治癒精神創傷的《REFRAME》、外星人大戰機械人的《屯門大戰天水圍》、細味孤獨與懸念的《圓念》、追尋記憶中熟悉滋味的《暴走廚神 大龍鳳》、反思生命價值與存在意義的《再生人型》、以及由謊言引爆異變災難的《無涯之約》。

director: Mandy Tsang, Kat Luk,  So Yat Man,  Lau Ho Leung,  Ng Kai Chung, Tsang Fung Chi, James Hung
